ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AAA Technologies Limited has announced September 23, 2026, as the record date for its recommended final dividend of Re. 1.00 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26. This dividend payment, contingent on shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting, will be made to eligible shareholders within 30 days of approval, representing a routine return of capital with no discernible red flags.
